svg.text: What moves through a gateway, and where it comes from: requests, configuration, and the signals and telemetry that flow back. gw-b runs the identical stack as the VRRP BACKUP.
a visitor reaching a team's sandbox, through whichever gateway holds the VIP
a route added or removed reaches both gateways as a signed, verified, probed config version
ipo-agent: the config pipeline, the only way a config reaches Traefik (runs on both gateways)
PUT /config over mTLS to both agents, or their 5 s pull

Version rules: a version goes live only when both gateways ack it; a rejected one is never retried (a transport failure is, with backoff); rollback re-issues an earlier body under a higher number. If the control plane is down both gateways keep serving the last version they verified.
what the gateways report back, and what the control plane does with it
